name: Don't Abandon Me
source:
Rumors that the spirits of bloodthirsty criminals reside in an abandoned building nearby start to spread in your hometown.  Your friends ask you to go check it out, and initially you refused. However, the offer they made was too good to pass up, so you decide to go. Once you get there, something happens, and now, you must find a way to escape. This trip might just end in your demise... Or you might find something unexpected out of it!

[from [url=https://judh4.itch.io/dont-abandon-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
关于嗜血罪犯的灵魂居住在附近一栋废弃建筑中的谣言开始在你的家乡传播。你的朋友邀请你去看看，一开始你拒绝了。然而，他们提供的报价太好了，不容拒绝，所以你决定去。一旦你到达那里，就会发生一些事情，现在，你必须找到逃跑的方法。这次旅行可能会以你的死亡告终……或者你可能会从中发现一些意想不到的东西！

[来自[url=https://judh4.itch.io/dont-abandon-me]itch.io[/url]]
